summary: The Dreamer background research loop is switched off pending the agent-loop revision. It had produced two rows from 963 messages (both wrong) and was failing every tick on one scope with a token-budget runaway that held its watermark, so the batch grew and the failure repeated. Nothing user-visible is lost: the <facts>, <room_exchange> and <room_portrait> blocks were already empty, and the two standing lexeme rows are unaffected.
details: See design/dreamer-agent-loop/ for the investigation and the revision that must land before this is switched back on.
[language] stays enabled — the legacy room-language and room-exchange consolidators are unaffected and still run.
limitations: While off, no fact candidates are extracted and no adjudication runs.
